_comment: DIAB GS30 grid-scored core WITH the stochastic resin halo (see notes/refs/laustsen2014_grid_scored_rve.md). Same nominal geometry as diab_gs30.json, but the saw cut opens foam cells along the groove walls and root; opened cells take up resin. 'cell_size' is the foam cell-size distribution: a scalar (uniform, P(resin)=1-d/cell_size) or {mean, std, dist:'lognormal'|'normal'}. The resin-presence probability P = survival function of that distribution vs distance to the nearest CUT surface (groove walls + root, NOT the un-sawn outer faces), evaluated at integration points; local stiffness is a rule of mixtures P*C_resin+(1-P)*C_foam. scoring.sampling = 'exact' (P at each Gauss point) or 'local_cloud' (sub-point cloud, inverse-distance-weighted to Gauss points). Requires the numpy backend (auto-routed).
